item.title: Beginner Home Workout With No Equipment: A Gentle 15-Minute Plan
item.description: A beginner home workout with no equipment that takes 15 minutes. Five low-impact moves, easier and harder options for each, and a simple weekly plan. Made for people who have never followed a routine before. Guide contains affiliate links.
